facts.fact: The CBN 2025 Annual Report, as reported by Punch, shows Nigeria had 84 licensed Payment Service Providers at end-2025, including eight Mobile Money Operators and seven Switching and Processing companies.

NGA.note: Document states no consumer-protection rule, complaints body or enforcement.
Document does not mention cross-border payments.
Document does not mention government payments to people.
No survey of adults with accounts; only transaction counts and values.

facts.fact: The CBN 2025 Annual Report, as reported by Punch, says Mobile Money Operators processed 28,741.83 million transactions worth N372.14tn in 2025.

NGA.note: Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
